subject: Startups
title: Lessons from Fallen Unicorns
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Lessons from Fallen Unicorns.

hook.text: For every unicorn success story, there are dozens that crashed. The failures teach more than the wins.

buildup.text: Pattern one: unchecked founders. WeWork, Theranos, and FTX all had charismatic leaders with no real oversight.

climax.text: The lesson: unicorn status isn't an achievement. It's a valuation. Real success is building a company that lasts.

punchline.text: A billion-dollar valuation means nothing without a real business.

quiz.question: What common pattern appears in most fallen unicorns?
options: Unchecked founders and growth over fundamentals
